scheduler.reason: Bounded nine-case reference and graph construction with fresh reviews, at most one correction at each level, and eligible pair review; the earlier complex-case pilot exceeded 90 minutes.

replaces.reason: Include the tested original-document input and explicit source-ancestry archival fixes before native construction. The earlier submission record remains unchanged.

old_pilot.known_launcher_failure: Historical launcher archival wrote outside its permitted output scope; the new launcher preserves its existing results through a separate explicit phase.
old_pilot.boundary: No accepted final Drop-seq graph review was produced. Old negative/unassessed results and original assessment versions remain unchanged. A later scancel request does not establish that cancellation caused the already recorded final state.

source_preparation.boundary: Registered source packets are inputs ready for annotation, not proof that all necessary scientific facts are available. The full 12-case denominator is retained.

host_render_probe.boundary: The host rendered and inspected the guide cover. This is not evidence of a native agent image call or complete transcription adjudication.

original_source_closure.boundary: Exact declared ancestry and byte preservation are distinct from semantic fidelity. One legacy Nextera rendition is explicitly a manual selected transcription, not a reproducible automatic conversion. Historical archives with incomplete ancestry retain their original status.

software_validation.boundary: These are software checks, not scientific accuracy results.

graph_contract.reason: The existing representation supports explicit material/data states, multi-input/output operations, typed flows, conditions and local modules. No inspected source-supported case has demonstrated a schema blocker. Any later justified change must propagate to the extractor, assembly, validation and versioned migration.

boundary: Model-authored, fresh-session model-reviewed reference candidates. Not expert gold, blind extraction performance, whole-graph precision, contamination-free held-out evaluation, a novelty benchmark or production graph admission.
